coverage_assessments.rationale: The completion criteria require a provision specifying when the agent's obligations terminate after the end of a mandate and any exceptions. None of the candidate provisions (C001–C022) relate to mandate law (위임) or the termination of an agent's duties under the Civil Code. They concern audit reporting, protection periods, tax withholding, pension reporting, port development, bus driver rest, financial-sector customer protection, and general headings on absence or crime discovery, none of which satisfy the criteria.

The completion criteria require a provision explicitly stating the agent's duty to take measures in an emergency after the mandate has ended due to the principal's absence. None of the candidate provisions govern mandate law or an agent's post-termination emergency duties. C019 and C020 are merely headings for 'Disappearance and Absence' under the Private International Law Act and contain no operative text on mandate-related emergency duties. C022 mentions claims arising from acts done out of urgent necessity after termination of a mandate, but it defines the scope of bankruptcy estate claims rather than establishing the agent's duty to act. All other provisions are unrelated.

The completion criteria require a provision specifying limitations or exclusions on the agent's emergency duty after the mandate ends. Since no candidate provision establishes the underlying emergency duty, none can specify its limitations. All candidate provisions are unrelated to mandate law or emergency duties.
